findings: In `components[0].sound[2].text`, change “share rhyme and rising-tone notation” to say they share the rhyme notation but differ in initial and tone notation. Baxter–Sagart gives 景 *C.qraŋʔ and 影 *qraŋʔ: the final ʔ is present in both, but the prefixed C. in 景 is part of its notation and the two forms are not described as sharing the same tone notation.
